neighbours.label: descriptions of bicycle components and specs (handlebars, drivetrain, brakes, tires, bearings)
fire: The gravel bike ships with flared handlebars and an eleven-speed drivetrain.
Our commuter bike has fenders, a rear rack and puncture-resistant tires.
The road bike pairs a carbon fork with mechanical disc brakes and clipless pedals.
This fat bike rolls on four-inch tires and a single-speed chainring.
The new cyclocross frame takes wider tires and a one-by gear setup.
Her mountain bike has a dropper post, tubeless tires and a long travel fork.
The folding bike uses a hub gear and a belt drive instead of a chain.
The kids' bike comes with coaster brakes, training wheels and a padded saddle.
quiet: The gaming laptop ships with a backlit keyboard and a fast graphics card.
Our family car has heated seats, a roof rack and all-season tires.
The desk lamp pairs a metal arm with a dimmer switch and a heavy base.
This blender runs on a strong motor and a single steel blade.
The new treadmill frame folds flat and has a quiet belt motor.
Her office chair has a mesh back, padded arms and a tall headrest.
The sewing machine uses a foot pedal and a light instead of a crank.
The baby stroller comes with a sun canopy, a basket and a padded seat.

notes: Probe: bike spec sentences 0.41-0.96; office chair 0.03, car 0.15; director list 0.004. Near misses keep the product-spec style for non-bike products (stroller and car have wheels/tires and may leak).
